description: FreightFA's newest freight news: FreightFA Pulse market stories and updates (truck, rail, ocean, industry), articles from The FreightFA Brief newsletter, videos, and podcast episodes. Returns titles, dates, short summaries and links, newest first. Filter by source or by a topic keyword such as 'intermodal' or 'tariffs'. Works with no inputs. Use it for what is happening in freight right now; cite the linked page. Does not count toward the monthly allowance.

limit.description: How many items to return. Defaults to 8.

source.description: Which feed: all (default), pulse (daily stories and market updates), articles (The FreightFA Brief), videos, or podcast.

topic.description: Optional keyword or two to match in titles and summaries, e.g. 'ocean rates'.

name: get_freight_news
title: Latest freight news from FreightFA
